p1: I design and build platforms end to end — from databases and microservices to interfaces and hardware.
p2: My main focus is Python backend: async services, message queues, ETL and integrations. I bring in computer vision and ML, build IoT solutions and mentor the next generation of engineers.

backend.title: Backend & microservices
backend.text: FastAPI, Django, async, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL — reliable services and APIs.

frontend.title: Interfaces
frontend.text: Vue.js and modern frontend: from admin panels to public websites.

iot.title: IoT & ML
iot.text: Devices, data collection, computer vision with OpenCV and TensorFlow models.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.text: Sharing experience and helping new engineers grow through practice and real projects.
